extracted.intended_audience: regulated entities and compliance officers (aircraft operators and maintenance personnel, airlines, securities issuers/filers, pesticide registrants and food industry, firms subject to FTC orders)
extracted.subtask_description: Collection of federal regulatory amendments, airworthiness directives, agency orders, reporting requirements, pesticide tolerances, and procedural instructions published in the Federal Register. Covers compliance, inspection, reporting, labeling, and objection/hearing procedures across multiple agencies.

rubrics_metrics.name: First-stage compressor rotor disc removal schedule
rubrics_metrics.description: Discs with more than 10,800 cycles or 2,850 hours on the effective date of this AD must be removed from service prior to the accumulation of 200 additional cycles or within the next 50 hours whichever occurs first. Discs with 10,800 cycles or less or 2,850 hours or less on the effective date of this AD must be removed before 11,000 cycles or 2,900 hours whichever occurs first.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This amendment is effective January 9, 1968. The AD cites specific G.E. P/Ns (37D400218P101, 37D400218P101 CEB No. 148, 37D400359P101 and 37D400359P102).

rubrics_metrics.name: Definition of a cycle (engine)
rubrics_metrics.description: For the purposes of this AD a cycle is considered as any engine operating sequence involving engine start, at least one acceleration to a power required for take off, and shutdown.

rubrics_metrics.name: Canadair CL-44D4 bogie beam inspection requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: Inspect the left and right main landing gear bogie beam P/N 44-87574 for cracks in accordance with the 'Inspection Procedure' outlined in Canadair Service Information Circular (SIC) No. 341, Issue No. 4, dated April 21, 1967, or later FAA-approved revision, or FAA-approved equivalent method.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Disregard the term 'after receipt of this Special Inspection' where mentioned in the Canadair SIC. Prior to each inspection, remove foreign matter from the area to be inspected.

rubrics_metrics.name: Replacement requirement for cracked bogie beam parts
rubrics_metrics.description: Replace cracked parts before further flight with a part of the same part number or an FAA-approved equivalent part.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Inspect replacement parts in accordance with subparagraphs 1.3.2 and 1.3.3 or 2.3.1 and 2.4.2 as applicable of the Canadair SIC prior to installation, or FAA-approved equivalent inspection. All repetitive inspections required by this AD also apply to replacement parts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Approval of equivalent inspections, parts, and SIC revisions
rubrics_metrics.description: Equivalent inspections may be approved by an FAA maintenance inspector. Equivalent parts and SIC revisions must be approved by the Chief, Engineering and Manufacturing Branch, FAA Eastern Region.

rubrics_metrics.name: Request procedure to increase compliance times (FAA AD)
rubrics_metrics.description: Upon request with substantiating data submitted through an FAA maintenance inspector, the compliance times specified in this AD may be increased by the Chief, Engineering and Manufacturing Branch, FAA Eastern Region.

rubrics_metrics.name: Supersession of AD 65-11-2 for Canadair CL-44D4
rubrics_metrics.description: AD 65-11-2 (Arndt. 39-65) is superseded and revoked, and replaced by a less restrictive directive referencing Canadair Information Circular No. 341 (April 21, 1967) with an increased inspection interval for certain bogie beams.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Because this amendment relieves a restriction and imposes no additional burden, notice and public procedure were deemed unnecessary and the amendment made effective in less than 30 days (effective January 9, 1968).

rubrics_metrics.name: Runway clear zone definition (§151.9(b))
rubrics_metrics.description: A runway clear zone is an area at ground level which begins at the end of each primary surface defined in §77.27(a) and extends with the width of each approach surface defined in §77.27(b) and (c), to terminate directly below each approach surface slope at the point(s) where the slope reaches a height of 50 feet above the elevation of the runway or 50 feet above the terrain at the outer extremity of the clear zone, whichever distance is shorter.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Amendment substitutes the pertinent portion formerly in §77.19(c) for present §151.9(b); effective January 9, 1968.

rubrics_metrics.name: Temporary authority to operate—carry pink duplicate (§47.31)
rubrics_metrics.description: After an applicant submits an Application for Aircraft Registration under §47.31(a), §47.31(b) requires him to carry the second duplicate copy (pink) in the aircraft as temporary authority to operate it without registration.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is a correction to previously published text (F.R. Doc. 68-13).

rubrics_metrics.name: SEC Regulation AD—periodic reports (60 days)
rubrics_metrics.description: Within 60 days after the end of each fiscal quarter, the Asian Development Bank shall file with the SEC: (1) information as to any purchases or sales by the Bank of its primary obligations during such quarter; (2) copies of the Bank's regular quarterly financial statement; (3) copies of any material modifications or amendments during such quarter of any exhibits previously filed under any statute (with narrow exceptions).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Copies of each annual report of the Bank to its Board of Governors shall be filed within 10 days after submission to the Board.

rubrics_metrics.name: SEC reports for proposed distribution—timing (Rule 287.3)
rubrics_metrics.description: The Bank shall file with the Commission not less than seven days prior to the date on which it proposes to sell any of its primary obligations in the United States, or such shorter period as the Commission may authorize, a report containing the information and documents specified in Schedule A (17 CFR 287.101).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The term 'sell' means the making of a completed sale or a firm commitment to sell.

rubrics_metrics.name: Preparation and filing formalities for SEC reports
rubrics_metrics.description: Every report must be filed under cover of a letter of transmittal stating the nature of the report and indicating the particular rule and subdivision under which the report is filed; at least the original letter must be signed on behalf of the Bank by a duly authorized officer.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Two copies of every report (including transmittal, exhibits, and documents) shall be filed. Reports shall be in English; foreign-language exhibits must have English translations. Reports pursuant to Rule 3 may be filed in the form of a prospectus to the extent the prospectus contains Schedule A information.

rubrics_metrics.name: Schedule A, Item 1—Description of obligations (a–i)
rubrics_metrics.description: For each issue to be distributed, furnish: (a) the title and date of the issue; (b) the interest rate and interest payment dates; (c) the maturity date or plan of serial maturities and circumstances for acceleration; (d) brief outline of any redemption and any amortization, sinking fund or retirement provisions stating annual amounts; (e) if secured by any lien, the kind and priority thereof and nature of the property subject to the lien; (f) describe any obligations that will rank prior as to payment of interest or principal; (g) outline provisions under which terms may be amended or modified by holders; (h) outline any other material provisions of the governing instruments pertaining to holders' rights or Bank duties; (i) name and address of fiscal or paying agent, if any.

rubrics_metrics.name: Schedule A, Item 2—Distribution of obligations (a–c)
rubrics_metrics.description: (a) Outline briefly the plan of distribution of the obligations and state the amount of participation of each principal underwriter, if any. (b) Describe any arrangements known to the Bank or any principal underwriter designed to stabilize the market for the obligations and indicate whether any transactions have already been effected to accomplish that purpose. (c) Describe any arrangements for withholding commissions, or otherwise, to hold each underwriter or dealer responsible for the distribution of his participation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Schedule A, Item 3—Distribution spread (tabular disclosure)
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide, in substantially the tabular form indicated, the following for obligations offered for cash (estimate if necessary): Price to the public; Selling discounts and commissions; Proceeds to the Bank.

rubrics_metrics.name: Schedule A, Item 4—Discounts and commissions to sub-underwriters and dealers
rubrics_metrics.description: State briefly the discounts and commission to be allowed or paid to dealers. If any dealers act as sub-underwriters and are to be allowed or paid additional discounts or commissions, a general statement to that effect will suffice without giving additional amounts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Schedule A, Item 5—Other expenses of distribution (itemization instruction)
rubrics_metrics.description: Furnish a reasonably itemized statement of all expenses of the Bank in connection with issuance and distribution of the obligations, except underwriters' or dealers' discounts and commissions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Insofar as practicable, itemization should include transfer agents' fees, cost of printing and engraving, and legal and accounting fees. Information may be subject to future contingencies; unknown amounts may be given as estimates designated as such.

rubrics_metrics.name: Schedule A, Item 6—Application of proceeds
rubrics_metrics.description: Make a reasonably itemized statement of the purposes, so far as determinable, for which the net proceeds to the Bank from the obligations are to be used, and state the approximate amount to be used for each such purpose.

rubrics_metrics.name: Schedule A, Item 7—Exhibits to be furnished (a–d)
rubrics_metrics.description: Attach or furnish as part of the report: (a) copies of the constituent instruments defining the rights evidenced by the obligations; (b) copies of an opinion of counsel, in English, as to the legality of the obligations; (c) copies of all material contracts pertaining to issuance or distribution of the obligations to which the Bank or any principal underwriter is or is to be a party, except selling group agreements; (d) copies of any prospectus or other sales literature to be provided by the Bank or principal underwriters for general use in connection with initial distribution.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of the word 'solder'—FTC Swiss Laboratory order
rubrics_metrics.description: Using the word 'solder' to describe any product which does not form a metallic seal or bond is prohibited: provided, however, that the word 'solder' may be used if it is clearly disclosed in conjunction therewith that the product is nonmetallic.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Nothing herein shall prohibit the use of 'solder' with clear disclosure that the product is nonmetallic; misrepresenting the composition of the product is prohibited.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prohibition on misbranding textile fiber products (Noga Waste Co.)
rubrics_metrics.description: Respondents shall cease and desist from: (1) falsely or deceptively stamping, tagging, labeling, invoicing, advertising, or otherwise identifying such products as to the name or amount of constituent fibers contained therein; (2) failing to affix a stamp, tag, label, or other means of identification to each product showing in a clear, legible, and conspicuous manner each element of information required to be disclosed by section 4(b) of the Textile Fiber Products Identification Act; (3) failing to maintain and preserve proper records showing the fiber content of textile fiber products as required by section 6 of the Act and Rule 39.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Respondents must, within sixty (60) days after service of the order, file with the Commission a written report setting forth in detail the manner and form in which they have complied with the order.

rubrics_metrics.name: Pesticide tolerance objection and hearing procedure
rubrics_metrics.description: Any person who will be adversely affected by the order may within 30 days from the date of its publication file written objections with the Hearing Clerk specifying how they will be adversely affected, the provisions objected to with particularity, and the grounds for the objections. If a hearing is requested, objections must state the issues for the hearing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A hearing will be granted if the objections are supported by grounds legally sufficient to justify the relief sought. Objections may be accompanied by a memorandum or brief in support thereof.

rubrics_metrics.name: Diuron tolerances established (§120.106)
rubrics_metrics.description: Establishes tolerances for diuron residues: 7 parts per million in or on asparagus, Bermudagrass, and Bermudagrass hay; 2 parts per million in or on alfalfa; corn fodder or forage (including sweet corn, field corn, and popcorn); grass crops (other than Bermudagrass); grass hay (other than Bermudagrass hay); hay, forage, and straw of barley, oats, rye, and wheat; hay and forage of birdsfoot trefoil, clover, peas, and vetch; sorghum fodder and forage.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Order effective on date of publication; objections allowed within 30 days as specified.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ethyl 4,4'-dichlorobenzilate tolerances (§120.109)
rubrics_metrics.description: Tolerances established for ethyl 4,4'-dichlorobenzilate residues: 15 parts per million in or on almond hulls; 5 parts per million in or on apples, citrus fruits, melons, pears; 0.5 part per million in meat, fat, and meat byproducts of cattle and sheep; 0.25 part per million in or on almonds (meat with shell removed).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Order effective on date of publication; objections allowed within 30 days as specified.

rubrics_metrics.name: Paraquat tolerances (§120.205)
rubrics_metrics.description: Tolerances established for paraquat residues: 0.5 part per million (negligible residue) in or on almond hulls, cottonseed, potatoes, sugar beets, sugar beet tops; 0.05 part per million in or on almonds, apples, apricots, avocados, bananas, cherries, citrus, coffee beans, corn (fresh vegetable), corn fodder and forage, corn grain, figs, filberts, grapes, lettuce, macadamia nuts, melons, nectarines, olives, papaya, peaches, pears, peppers, plums (fresh prunes), sorghum forage, sorghum grain, soybeans, soybean forage, tomatoes, walnuts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Some tolerances (cottonseed and potatoes) were established by prior orders. Order effective on date of publication; objections allowed within 30 days as specified.

rubrics_metrics.name: Revocation of food additive regulation—Nitrodan (§121.288)
rubrics_metrics.description: The food additive regulation (§121.288) providing for use of Nitrodan as an anthelmintic in cereal-type dog food is revoked.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: No comments were received to the October 24, 1967 notice proposing revocation; revocation is effected pursuant to the Federal Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act authority cited.
